ranking_methodology: Overall order is a qualitative decision-support shortlist, not a weighted score or price sort. It prioritizes documented fit to the requested Queen/King bed and private bath, then the dated 7-night quote plus cancellation/breakfast terms, walkable or on-property MICHELIN dining and Metro access, and unresolved property alerts; each row states its reason. All nine properties tie at 18/18 only within the curated subset (11 starred, 3 Bib Gourmand, 4 MICHELIN Selected), not the full 153-entry Shanghai Guide; the raw count does not distinguish these hotels and is not used to rank them. A separate price rank in the quote cell orders the eight recorded USD seven-night totals from low to high; The Peninsula has no comparable live USD checkout total and is unranked. Quote totals are not normalized for room type, breakfast, refundability, or other terms; where multiple beds have different prices, the displayed total is the lower recorded option and the exact room must be reselected at checkout. Room-fit uncertainties remain flagged and are not booking-ready until confirmed. Route times are dated rail/short-walk estimates, not guaranteed door-to-door times; see F04–F05, F16, F18, F19, and F21.
